Description: Consumer Price Index for the full basket of goods and services. Its year-over-year change is the headline inflation rate.
CPI component for shelter: rented accommodation, owned accommodation, and water, fuel and electricity.
CPI component for rented accommodation: rent and other costs paid by tenants.
CPI component for the costs of owning a home, such as mortgage interest cost, homeowners' replacement cost, property taxes, insurance, and maintenance and repairs.
CPI component for water, fuel and electricity used in the home.
CPI component for food from stores and restaurants. Published for Canada and the province only, not for St. John's.
CPI special aggregate for energy, such as electricity, fuel oil and gasoline. Published for Canada and the province only, not for St. John's.
Unemployed people as a percentage of the labour force, population aged 15 and over.
Employed people as a percentage of the population aged 15 and over.
Labour force (employed plus unemployed) as a percentage of the population aged 15 and over.
Number of employed people aged 15 and over, in thousands.

IndicatorName: Unemployment rate, standard error of estimate
Description: Standard error of the unemployment rate estimate. Used to draw 95% confidence bands.

IndicatorName: Unemployment rate, standard error of year-over-year change
Description: Standard error of the 12-month change in the unemployment rate. Used to test whether a change is statistically significant.
Standard error of the employment estimate, in thousands of people.

IndicatorName: Employment, standard error of year-over-year change
Description: Standard error of the 12-month change in employment, in thousands of people.
Estimated total population on July 1 of each year.

IndicatorName: New Housing Price Index, total (house and land)
Description: Change over time in contractors' selling prices of new homes whose specifications stay the same, house and land combined.

IndicatorName: New Housing Price Index, house only
Description: New Housing Price Index, house (structure) component only.

IndicatorName: New Housing Price Index, land only
Description: New Housing Price Index, land component only.
Number of dwelling units created by residential building permits (all types of work, including new construction and conversions). Measures permitted supply, not completions.
Dwelling units created by permits for single-dwelling buildings (single houses, mobile homes and cottages).
Dwelling units created by permits for multiple-dwelling buildings (doubles, row houses and apartments).
